pattern: SELECT ([a-z]+).([a-z]+) FROM ([a-z]+) JOIN ([a-z]+)([a-z]+) ON ([a-z]+).([a-z]+) = ([a-z]+)\.(CountryCode|Language) WHERE ([a-z]+)\.(Language|CountryCode) = '(.*)' OR ([a-z]+)\.(Language|CountryCode) = '(.*)'
correction: Use aliases for both tables, select the correct column from the country table, and include conditions for all specified languages in the join condition.

metadata.description: This rule identifies errors where the join condition does not include a condition for all specified languages, and selects an incorrect column from the country table.
